csv_project_name: Design Service for Hebron Fish Hatchery Improvements Phase 2
csv_scope_of_work: ODNR intends to procure Architect / Engineering Services for the second phase of a renovation project at Hebron State Fish Hatchery, located in Licking County, Ohio. Phase 1, currently underway, includes the installation of new water line(s) between the Hebron Fish Hatchery system and Buckeye Lake, which serves as the source of the hatchery s water supply. The project scope for Phase 2 includes the installation of new drum filters, construction of a new filter building, updated electrical service to additional ponds, replacement of the existing pole barn and replacement of iron filters. Water filtration through the installation of drum filters and a new filter building is necessary to limit the introduction of undesirable fish and debris to Hebron Fish Hatchery from the source water.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Testing, Analytical/Testing Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
